04
What we automated there
One path · three steps

Onboarding. KYC. Letter.

01
Register
The client opens a case in a minute — company, freelancer or natural person — on the channel they already use.
02
Details & documents
A questionnaire plus the document pack. The system parses files, flags gaps, and can email a request for what is still missing.
03
Engagement letter
If the pack is complete, the letter goes out for signature. A person in the firm can fill a gap, request more, or submit the case.

The 80% is overall manual hours in that engagement — not a per-workflow result, and not a forecast for Across Legal.

01 · Register
Company, freelancer or person. Opens the case.
02 · Details

03 · Waiting

06
The firm side
Working product · case review

Every field has a source.

The reviewer sees extracted values, the document they came from, and confidence. They can submit — or ask the client for more. Nothing silent.

07
The human seat
The rule in every build

Agents prepare.
People decide.

Nothing binding, legal, or client-facing leaves without a named person. Software does not make a firm compliant.

Stays with the lawyer
KYC sufficiency, AML risk, whether the matter proceeds, any report, any send.
Moves to the agent
Collect, classify, spot gaps, structure facts, assemble the pack, draft the follow-up.
Always named
A process owner reviews exceptions. The system never silently passes a missing file.
